title: Understanding the Plot
text: Observe the scatter plot. It shows a clear negative linear trend. This means that as the x-values increase, the y-values decrease.

title: Effect of Regularization
text: Regularization can help prevent overfitting by penalizing large coefficients. In this case, we are using a fixed lambda value of $$2$$.

title: Comparing Parameters
text: Consider how regularization affects the parameters in the context of a negative linear trend. Which parameter is likely to fit the trend better?

title: Choosing the Parameter
text: Given the negative linear trend and the effect of regularization, which parameter is likely to achieve a lower test MSE?
